IAS 2 (Inventories) [IFRS]: Inventory is carried at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Cost formulas are first-in first-out (FIFO) or weighted average only, so last-in first-out (LIFO) is prohibited, in contrast to US GAAP, which permits LIFO. Write-downs are reversed when the cause disappears, limited to the original write-down. Analyst impact: No LIFO reserve exists for IFRS reporters; for US peers use the LIFO reserve to restate to FIFO. Adjustment recipe: lifo_to_fifo.
